prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally overoptimistic, though recent winning tests (like home wait info) were underpredicted.
Adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance or failed to help across multiple tests.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) and adding home wait info (home, wait_info) produced winning tests, but evidence remains thin with only one test each.
Redesigning the home screen (home, redesign) hurt performance, but evidence is still thin from a single test.
Evidence remains thin for all other change types (hints, incentives, new flows, adoption wait info) as each has only been tested once.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +2.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, wait_info: +2.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, incentive: -2.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, hint: -1.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -4.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, hint: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +5.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, copy: -0.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after waiting screen: Move the sign-in step to occur right after pet generation completes on the waiting screen. (why: The sign-in step has a 567s mean duration, and letting users wait for generation first reduces setup friction.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Pet Desktop Placement Preview Screen: Add a new preview screen right before finishing onboarding to demonstrate how the pet lives on the desktop taskbar. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding pets not appearing on screen or confusion on desktop interaction.)
2: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Status Checklist Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen layout to a checklist structure showing real-time pet rendering stages. (why: The home waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing drop-offs due to uncertainty.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Quick Start Preset Adoption Flow: Introduce a fast-track instant adoption action on the pick_friend screen to adopt standard pets without photo uploads. (why: Adoption step conversion is only 60.9% with a high mean time of 1017s, and photo generation can fail.)
4: [home, notification] Completion Sound Notification on Waiting Screen: Play a completion chime and send a system notification when generation finishes on the waiting screen. (why: Users leave the app idling in the background during long waits (mean 2336s) and do not notice when ready.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Hint: Add a account recovery hint on the sign-in screen explaining pet account synchronization. (why: Support received 8 emails reporting missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Compact Layout: Change story screen layout to compact to move users into path choice faster. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, indicating stalling early in onboarding.)
7: [home, wait_info] Time Remaining Countdown Estimate: Display a dynamic time estimate countdown timer on the waiting screen. (why: High mean wait time (2336s) on the waiting screen leads users to abandon the app while generation runs.)
8: [finish, incentive] Home Intro Companion Controls Guide Badge: Add an interactive controls guide badge component to the home_intro screen. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and post-onboarding support indicates confusion regarding pet controls.)

scores.note: Reordering sign-in previously showed positive results (+2.8%), targeting a high-duration sign-in step.
Strong evidence from support and funnel, but adding new finish screens consistently hurts performance.
Home screen redesigns previously hurt conversion (-3.0%) and require building a new layout.
Targets adoption step with 39.1% drop-off; new flow showed modest gain (+2.4%) in past tests.
Addresses long wait time (2336s mean) via background notifications, but untested as a notification pattern.
Strong support mail alignment and low cost, but sign-in copy tweaks consistently show no clear effect.
Targets 23.8% drop-off and 514s mean duration on choose_path with a minor layout adjustment.
Home wait info changes are proven winners (+5.0%) for mitigating drop-off during long generation times.
Supported by support feedback on high drop-off finish step, but hints/incentives on finish step underperformed.
